# App Measurement
> App Measurement provides mobile app attribution, analytics, and campaign measurement solutions for marketers and developers.

App Measurement helps businesses measure app installs, in-app events, and marketing performance across channels. Its site includes product information, attribution and analytics resources, partner and integration details, support content, and company information relevant to evaluating and implementing mobile measurement.

## Product
- [Overview](https://app-measurement.com/): Main overview of App Measurement’s mobile attribution and analytics offering.
- [Attribution](https://app-measurement.com/attribution/): Explains install and event attribution for mobile marketing campaigns.
- [Analytics](https://app-measurement.com/analytics/): Describes app analytics capabilities for measuring user behavior and performance.
- [Fraud Prevention](https://app-measurement.com/fraud-prevention/): Covers tools and methods for detecting and reducing ad fraud.
- [Deep Linking](https://app-measurement.com/deep-linking/): Describes deep linking capabilities for app engagement and campaign routing.
- [SKAdNetwork](https://app-measurement.com/skadnetwork/): Explains support for Apple SKAdNetwork measurement and attribution.

## Solutions
- [For Marketers](https://app-measurement.com/for-marketers/): Product positioning and workflows tailored to marketing teams.
- [For Developers](https://app-measurement.com/for-developers/): Information relevant to technical implementation and app instrumentation.
- [Gaming](https://app-measurement.com/gaming/): Measurement use cases and benefits for gaming apps.
- [E-commerce](https://app-measurement.com/e-commerce/): Attribution and analytics scenarios for commerce-focused mobile apps.
- [Subscription Apps](https://app-measurement.com/subscription-apps/): Measurement considerations for subscription-based app businesses.

## Integrations and Partners
- [Partners](https://app-measurement.com/partners/): Directory or overview of ecosystem partners and supported platforms.
- [Ad Networks](https://app-measurement.com/ad-networks/): Information about media source and ad network integrations.
- [Analytics Integrations](https://app-measurement.com/analytics-integrations/): Describes integrations with analytics and reporting tools.
- [Data Integrations](https://app-measurement.com/data-integrations/): Covers data export, ingestion, and interoperability options.
- [Agency Partners](https://app-measurement.com/agency-partners/): Information for agencies working with App Measurement customers.

## Documentation

- [Event Tracking](https://app-measurement.com/docs/event-tracking/): Documentation for configuring and sending in-app events.
- [Attribution Setup](https://app-measurement.com/docs/attribution-setup/): Instructions for configuring attribution and campaign measurement.
- [Deep Linking Setup](https://app-measurement.com/docs/deep-linking/): Technical setup guidance for deep linking features.
- [SKAdNetwork Guide](https://app-measurement.com/docs/skadnetwork/): Implementation details for Apple privacy-centric attribution.

## API and Developer Tools
- [API Reference](https://app-measurement.com/api/): Reference documentation for available APIs and endpoints.

- [Reporting API](https://app-measurement.com/api/reporting/): Endpoints for retrieving attribution and analytics data.
- [Postbacks API](https://app-measurement.com/api/postbacks/): Technical details for configuring and consuming postbacks.
- [Webhooks](https://app-measurement.com/api/webhooks/): Event-driven integration options for external systems.
- [Developer Center](https://app-measurement.com/developers/): Hub for developer-facing tools, references, and integration materials.
